ns2:course.label: French Civilization I
ns2:course.description: Survey of French life and French institutions, intended as a background for literary studies and as a preparation for the teaching of French; given in French. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: FR 205, FR 207, FR 209, and FR 210, or equivalent.
